name: Fabiola
source: [url=/c94625]Elze's[/url] mother. A natural airhead who is bright, cheerful, and does not worry about small details. She's often lost in her own thoughts and wanders into her own fantasy world when you least expect her to do so (she is a delusional mother). She loves to dote on her daughter, which sometimes can even come across as over-protection. She's not opposed to eroticism, but at the same time she wants to make sure that her daughter gets a proper sexual education and guidance.
